limits: Formal tailoring is an independently authored CQC Gala adaptation of young MGS3 Ocelot; the released game has no attested Gala costume.

Thirty-four native keyposes, including two genuinely crouched shooting bodies. Original action frame counts/FPS/phases are preserved by reuse of semantically appropriate keyposes, not by claiming a complete captured animation cycle.
Both faces are independently authored source bodies. The new two-body PNG contains disjoint true native regions; it is never mirrored.
Tiny SAA mechanical details, shoulders and posture retain drawn perspective variation. This is a close source-inspired adaptation, not certified 1:1 source model dimensions.
displayHeight230 is the existing gameplay presentation unit. New low-shot scale is calibrated from the head/beret and boots against the standing source, not stretched to standing silhouette height.
Original weak-alpha PNG fringe and all old sources/HOLD are retained. Source-native contour clips exclude adjacent figures without modifying any PNG.
